visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Merge Instead of Concatenate and Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The arrays are copied into one and sorted again, which ignores that they are already sorted. Merge them in a single pass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Merging takes n + m steps because it uses the fact that both inputs are sorted. Sorting everything again takes (n + m) log (n + m) steps and throws that information away.
